authorship: Independent synthetic documents/maps/identity/history expectations authored before native operation adapter execution; no production exports or runtime outputs used. JSON string serialization here only encodes authored ASCII-key/string-only literal trees under existing ADR004; it does not call production canonicalization.
phase: pre-adapter oracle freeze candidate; actual execution status belongs to later report
path_convention: Initial/expected paths relative to engine synthetic root. Existing labels bind once before dispatch. Created labels bind once from actual commit changed_nodes IDs at expected final paths, never invented serials; redo must revive those exact IDs.
selection_policy: All start with a collapsed After caret on guard leaf z at UTF16=1. Selection setup event drained before baseline. Expected guard label identity follows block movement; no raw-transaction query API is claimed.
committed_facets: guarded full authored/synthetic records and IDs
allocator_policy: Queries must be pure; refused real dispatch can reserve/burn identities for ABA safety. No allocator rewind/next-ID claim for execute refusal.
late_refusal_policy: Append exactly one reversed range on separate stable guard leaf AFTER primary batch; compare all public committed facets and identity map; repeat while redo exists after apply→undo. Expected code tree.invalid_range is from closed public native taxonomy.
history_policy: Isolated changed batch is exactly one history unit. Undo/redo advance document revision2/3 and restore exact saved IDs/content/marks/selection; dirty stays conservatively true. Default bounded retention is sufficient for these1-unit fixtures.
